mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signal a broad-based demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95 for two consecutive months indicates a supply shock, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 95 for two months, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive quarterly growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with positive GDPC1 growth, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeding 3.0% signals persistent inflation, prompting central bank tightening and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment (PAYEMS) and increases in unemployment (UNRATE) signal a rapidly deteriorating labor market, causing negative S&P 500 returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or the interaction signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high-inflation, low-rate regime (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%), the S&P 500 experiences negative returns over the next 20 trading days due to policy uncertainty.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%, or the signal's Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
